summary: SiteDocument is a data entity representing a document associated with a Site, containing identifiers for both the document and the Site.
purpose: To store and reference documents related to specific sites in the system.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Identifier for the Site to which the document is related.

summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin is a web page and user control for staff administrators, including workflows for site and discipline selection, date filtering, and employment application review.
purpose: To provide staff administrators with tools to filter, view, and manage student employment applications, including date and site/discipline-based filtering and access to application details.

fields.name: SiteID
fields.description: Filter for the Site being viewed.

fields.name: DisciplineID
fields.description: Filter for the Discipline being selected.

fields.name: SubmittedDate
fields.description: Date when the employment application was submitted.

fields.name: PlcAgencyShortName
fields.description: Short name of the placement agency.

workflows.name: Employment Application Filtering and Review
steps: Select Site and Discipline from dropdowns
Enter Start and End Dates for filtering
Click Refresh to update the view
Review applications in grid, with access to applicant details and email links
Application status and withdrawal information displayed
Handle errors and warnings via dedicated panels

business_rules: Applications must have valid start and end dates.
Start date must not be after end date.
Withdrawn applications can be shown or hidden via checkbox.
Applications are shown in paged grid view.
validations: Custom Validation: Start Date must be before End Date
conditions: Show withdrawn applications if checkbox checked.
Hide error/warning panels if no errors/warnings.
system_behavior: Bind grid data on refresh or filtering changes.
Display errors/warnings with option to hide panels.
Last login shown in footer panel.
dependencies: Sites and Disciplines lists come from data layer.
Grid view depends on ObjectDataSource with parameters.
exceptions: If session is null, cancel data selection.
If invalid dates entered, show validation error.

summary: ServiceCode is a data entity representing a code and its metadata, with support for localization and categorization.
purpose: To categorize and track service codes, including names, descriptions, sorting, and notes, with support for alternate language fields.

fields.name: CodeCategoryID
fields.description: Category ID the code belongs to.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Sort order for display or processing.

workflows.name: Service Code Listing
steps: Fetch list of ServiceCodes for session.
Localize data if alternative language mode enabled.

workflows.name: Service Code Options by Course or Timetable
steps: Fetch ServiceCodes based on CourseID or TimetableID as parameters.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, Name field is set to NameAlt.
Entries returned based on CourseID, TimetableID, or list all.
conditions: Localization changes field values if alt language mode is active.
system_behavior: Procedures fetch and populate ServiceCode objects.
Alternate language data used where applicable.
dependencies: Depends on HSPnetSession for language selection.

summary: SiteProfileHistory is a data entity capturing changes to Site profiles, including who made the change, when, and what fields or actions were modified.
purpose: To audit and track history of profile changes for Sites, supporting both standard and alternate language fields, and providing formatted representations for UI display.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the history entry.

fields.name: ActionDate
fields.description: Date and time of the action.

fields.name: ScreenSection
fields.description: Section of the screen modified (with alt version).

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of the user who performed the action.

fields.name: ByUserSysAdmin
fields.description: Indicates if the action was performed by a system admin.

workflows.name: Profile History Search
steps: Invoke procedure with SiteID, SessionAgencyID, and session.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is true, use alt fields for screen section/user action/fields.
Agency user formatting depends on system admin status and user identity.
calculations: Formatted name and tooltip details based on user and agency info.
conditions: Session is required for data access.
system_behavior: UI user control binds ObjectDataSource for history.
Tooltip and formatted details provided for display.
dependencies: Depends on database procedures and session.
UI binds and calls selection handler.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, cancel ObjectDataSource selection.

summary: EmailPopupDocument is a serializable data entity for representing email-related document files, including search and delete operations for files and folders.
purpose: To track, display, and manage files/document attachments surfaced in email popups, including deletion of files and folders.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for the document in popup context.

fields.name: Checked
fields.description: Whether the document is checked (selected) in the UI.

workflows.name: Popup Document Search
steps: Parse each entry into filename and path.

business_rules: Files are deleted along with their folders when removed.
Entries are constructed from delimited data strings.
conditions: If data info is null, empty, or does not match expected format, no entries returned or deleted.
system_behavior: Delete updates the data info and removes files/folders.
dependencies: Depends on file system for deletion.
exceptions: Deletion may fail if file/folder is locked or inaccessible; such errors are caught and ignored.
